phase_prompt.summary: Tesefhew in his standard archivist attire with active tech-integration.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Cinematic medium shot of Tesefhew, an elderly Ethiopian archivist from an ancient high-tech civilization. He has dark, weathered skin and a white beard braided with copper wires. He wears heavy ochre linen robes interwoven with dull gold circuitry patterns. Over his left eye is a primitive bronze-rimmed augmented reality lens. He wears a heavy basalt and gold mantle on his shoulders. He holds a dark slate tablet emitting faint holographic glyphs. The lighting is moody, chiaroscuro, illuminating the texture of the fabric and the weathered skin. Background is a dimly lit stone temple archive with floating dust motes. Photorealistic, 8k, unreal engine 5 render style, tactile texture.
